# Recorded fixtures for the country pack adapters (wave 7 PR4)

Every file here was shaped from a live response read on **5 October 2026** and then cut down to a handful of records.
Shapes (keys, nesting, encodings, delimiters, BOMs) are untouched; only the number of records and the length of long
text or geometry fields were reduced. The adapter tests (`test/country-adapters.test.ts`) run only against these files;
CI never touches the network.

| File | Shaped from | What was kept |
|---|---|---|
| `nsta-data.json` | `https://open-data-ukcs-transition.hub.arcgis.com/data.json` (DCAT-US 1.1 catalogue, 733 datasets that day) | The catalogue head and four datasets as published: `Q 170` (a PDF map with two distributions, so the resolver has to skip it), `UKCS offshore petroleum licences (WGS84)`, `UKCS 33rd offshore petroleum licencing rounds blocks on offer (WGS84)` and `UKCS offshore petroleum licence subareas by equity group holder (WGS84)`, each with all eleven distributions (ArcGIS Hub page, GeoService REST, CSV, GeoJSON, KML, Shapefile and so on). Descriptions cut to 400 characters. The `license` field is the hub's own HTML snippet naming the NSTA Open User Licence. |
| `nsta-layer.json` | `https://services-eu1.arcgis.com/OZMfUznmLTnWccBc/arcgis/rest/services/UKCS_offshore_petroleum_licence_subareas_by_equity_group_holder_(ED50)/FeatureServer/0?f=pjson` | Layer metadata: `name`, `type`, `maxRecordCount` (2000), `editingInfo` (last edit dates), `extent` and the 32 `fields` (name, type, alias, length). Rendering and template keys dropped. |
| `nsta-query.json` | The same layer, `query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&returnGeometry=false&resultOffset=0&resultRecordCount=3&f=json` | Verbatim: the three-feature response (`objectIdFieldName`, `fields`, `features[].attributes`). 1,801 rows existed on the layer that day (`returnCountOnly`). |
| `anh-layer0.json` | `https://geovisor.anh.gov.co/server/rest/services/Vista_Tierras_Version_Vigente_Geovisor/FeatureServer/0?f=pjson` | Layer metadata: `name` (`GDB.Tierras_Version_Vigente_Geovisor_Vista`), `maxRecordCount` (2000, the cap the research recorded), `extent` with spatial reference 9377 and the 21 `fields` (`CONTRATO_N`, `OPERADOR`, `CUENCA_SED`, `ESTAD_AREA`, `TIPO_CONTR`, `FECHA_FIRM` among them). |
| `anh-query.json` | The same layer, `query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&returnGeometry=false&resultOffset=0&resultRecordCount=2&f=json` | Verbatim: the two-feature response. |
| `ar-package-show.json` | `http://datos.energia.gob.ar/api/3/action/package_show?id=exploracion-hidrocarburos-permisos-de-exploracion` (plain HTTP; HTTPS redirects back to HTTP) | Verbatim: the CKAN envelope (`help`, `success`, `result`) with the package's two resources (CSV and SHP), `license_title` `CC-BY-4.0`, `metadata_modified` `2026-10-01T07:00:57`. |
| `ar-permisos-head.csv` | The CSV resource of that package, `exploracin-hidrocarburos-permisos-de-exploracin.csv` (67 lines, 173 kB) | The header line as published (UTF-8 BOM, comma separated, a `geojson` column holding a quoted MultiPolygon) and two rows whose geometry was cut to a four-vertex polygon. |
| `anp-blocos-ofertados-head.csv` | `https://www.gov.br/anp/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/dados-abertos/arquivos/rlpgn/blocos-ofertados-rodadas.csv` (1,682 lines, "atualizado em 6/3/2026" on the page) | The first six lines byte for byte: Windows-1252 (not UTF-8), semicolon separated, decimal comma, header `Rodada de Licitações;Bacia;Setor;Bloco;Habilitação Mínima; Bonus Mínimo ;Localização;Bloco arrematado`. |
| `sodir-licence-head.csv` | `https://factpages.sodir.no/public?/Factpages/external/tableview/licence&rs:Command=Render&rc:Toolbar=false&rc:Parameters=f&IpAddress=not_used&CultureCode=en&rs:Format=CSV&Top100=false` (the Export CSV link on `https://factpages.sodir.no/en/licence/TableView/Overview`; 1,815 lines) | The UTF-8 BOM, the header (`prlName` … `DatesyncNPD`) and the first three licences. `DatesyncNPD` carries the synchronisation date the page shows as "Time of last synchronization with Norwegian Offshore Directorate's internal systems 05.10.2026 - 01:39". |

None of these files contains personal data: the attributes are licence references, block names, company names, dates and areas.
